subject: F-10: no code change; gaps are recorded deviations
summary: I made no code change. The two remaining gaps are intentional, and removing them would regress behavior or break an existing test. (1) Photo mode skips round_trip_ok because its synthetic manifest is a bare click per step, so a descriptive caption can never round-trip. test_photo_polish_keeps_descriptive_vision_caption_rewrite pins this. (2) The claim gate is off for captures without a transcript because their claims are synthesized from the step texts, so the gate would revert every genuine rephrase. Making either unconditional would mean weakening a test or reverting valid output. CLAUDE.md rule 3 says that needs a recorded deviation and the user's sign-off, and phases/DEVIATIONS.md already records both. The sign-off is still pending in .audit/STATUS.md. Also, A-01 is held, so round_trip_ok is still only the verb/element/window substring check. Ruff check and format are clean. test_server.py and test_polish.py pass (154), and I did not run the full test suite. The post-polish gate, the polish_reverted_steps report field, the _RoundTripPassingStub swap, and the three new tests are already in place from the earlier pass.
